interface.shortDescription: Model routing, goal-driven delivery, task orchestration, review gates, and Oracle
interface.longDescription: Yardmaster is the delivery system for agent work: budget-aware model routing, intent-routed LFG-first delivery (the deliver skill), multi-agent and cross-machine orchestration (the orchestrate skill), deep review gates, Oracle second-model review, guided setup and doctor diagnosis, and Codex runtime hygiene. It only dispatches cross-machine work to hosts the sibling roundhouse plugin has verified are ready; machine administration itself lives there.
defaultPrompt: Use yardmaster to deliver this change through LFG, merge, and post-merge proof.
Use yardmaster to orchestrate this objective across tasks and machines.
Run the yardmaster doctor and fix anything out of sync.
